UserPromptSubmit.rule: A real user prompt may start or steer work but cannot bypass approval or contract lock.

PreToolUse.rule: Reject raw command fields, path escapes, policy mutation, and actions outside the locked scope.

PostToolUse.rule: Record bounded evidence and refresh concise status from the deterministic core.

Stop.rule: Allow stop only when Shipping reports SHIPPABLE/CLOSED or human stop; otherwise report the blocker or required verification.

SubagentStop.rule: Subagent completion is a receipt, never release completion.
